start: Owner signed in online on Today; an app user typed a member's mobile number at the poster check-in and it waits for the desk

steps.action: Find the card 'Numbers to confirm'
user_sees: 'Say yes only if the number is really theirs. This stops anyone checking in with someone else’s number.'
A row: '<member name> · +91 98290 48001'
'The app user “<name>” typed this number at check-in. Is it their number?'
Buttons 'No' and 'Yes, it’s theirs'
must_not: Rows of another gym
Rows already answered
Newest first (the oldest wait must be on top)

steps.action: Tap 'Yes, it’s theirs'
user_sees: The button reads 'Saving…'; every button on the card is off while it saves
must_not: A second answer sent by a second tap
Another row answered by mistake

steps.action: Wait
user_sees: The row leaves the card; Today's 'Needs you' count drops at once; with no rows left the card goes away
must_not: The row still waiting after a yes
The count staying up until the next minute

start: Owner on Today; a waiting number whose app user gave no name

steps.action: Read the row
user_sees: 'Someone in the app typed this number at check-in. Is it their number?'
must_not: Empty quote marks where the name would be

steps.action: Tap 'No'
user_sees: The row leaves the card and the count drops
must_not: The app user getting that number after a No
A question 'are you sure' that hides the list

start: Owner on Today with the card open; things go wrong

steps.action: Tap 'Yes, it’s theirs' on a row another person answered a moment ago
user_sees: 'Someone already answered this one. The list is up to date now.' and the list is read again
must_not: A second, different answer saved over the first

steps.action: Tap an answer with the internet off
user_sees: 'Could not save. Check the internet and try again.'; the row stays
must_not: The row leaving as if saved
Buttons left switched off for good

steps.action: Tap an answer while the gym account is on hold, or after being signed out elsewhere
user_sees: 'Your gym account is on hold, so this can’t be answered now.' / 'You have been signed out. Sign in again.'
must_not: A raw server code such as SUSPENDED or BAD_KEY on screen

steps.action: Open Today in the demo gym, or with nothing waiting
user_sees: No 'Numbers to confirm' card
must_not: An empty card with a title and no rows

start: Owner answered a number a minute ago

steps.action: Open Today again, press Refresh
user_sees: The answered row does not come back; only waiting numbers are shown
must_not: An answered number shown as waiting again

steps.action: Look for a way to take the answer back on this card
user_sees: There is none here: the card shows waiting numbers only
must_not: A yes silently turned into a no, or the other way round

steps.action: The same app user types the same number again after a No
user_sees: A new waiting row
must_not: The old No answering the new ask by itself without the desk seeing it

start: Owner; a waiting row shows a member's name and mobile number

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: Only this gym's member name, their mobile and the name the app user gave
must_not: The number shown to the app user or tied to their app account before the desk says yes
Numbers typed at another gym

steps.action: Say 'No' to a number that is not theirs
user_sees: The app user stays without that number
must_not: The real member's check-ins, plan or dues shown to the person who typed the number
